task: Read-only Toolbox2 battery/power parity and missing live power audit
decompilerCaution: Recovered source omits vFN branch in TLMUPDS and damages BTV/BTA ternaries/control flow. Important claims above were checked in original Lua5.3 bytecode. Do not execute the recovered fragments as production code.

features.toolbox: TBS battery modules bind RxBt (V), Curr (A), Capa (mAh), Bat% (%); none has a power value-conversion vFN.
features.aerodeck: Same CRSF defaults; voltage also falls back to VFAS and Bat. Manual Auto/None/source mappings are available.
features.consequence: There is no special Toolbox battery transport to copy. Confirm native sources/current flags before changing MSP.

features.toolbox: TLMSADD qualifies CHAR_TELEMETRY+name. TLMUPDS accepts only first getSourceValue return, clamps ranges, retains data while global telemetry controls dimming.
features.aerodeck: Qualified source lookup is shared/cached; numeric values must have current=true. Real zero remains present. Missing/stale values become nil/--.
features.consequence: Do not fix absent live values by copying Toolbox stale-value behavior.

features.toolbox: Binding is performed during telemetry initialization; no claim of better live rediscovery.
features.aerodeck: A missing qualified source is cached false until refreshSources. Sensors-page REFRESH only calls scanSensors and does not clear this cache; GPS refresh/reopen does.
features.consequence: Concrete possible cause when battery sensors were discovered after AERODECK opened; not proven to be this live failure.

features.toolbox: Power definitions declare expected engineering units/precision and TLMSADD records native unit/precision. No scaling function is attached to CRSF power fields.
features.aerodeck: Unit scan exists but read() checks/converts speed, angle, vertical speed and altitude only. Voltage/current/consumed/remaining accept any numeric unit after manual mapping.
features.consequence: A custom mA/Ah/wrong source could be mislabeled A/mAh/V; add explicit typed diagnostics and supported conversions rather than scaling already-correct CRSF values.

features.toolbox: Without a selected favourite, BTCNO infers 1–6S from pack voltage versus configured max cell voltage. With a favourite, uses its cell count. Cell display is pack/cells.
features.aerodeck: Manual battery cells default 0 (not set), or one of three profiles overrides 1–12S. No inference. Average voltage and battery checks are unavailable when cells remain unset.
features.consequence: Unset cells explains missing average/alerts only; it cannot hide actual pack voltage or current. Automatic inference is ambiguous on discharged packs, so do not silently treat it as measured cell count.

features.toolbox: Five independently enabled favourites, chemistry label, 1–99 cells and 100–100000mAh; dashboard chooser persists selection/cells/capacity.
features.aerodeck: Three profiles plus manual cells; 1–12 cells and 100–30000mAh; active profile and parameters saved via settings. No chemistry labels/enable toggles/dashboard chooser.
features.consequence: Parity gap in pack management; unrelated to native voltage/current availability.

features.toolbox: Bat% native by default; selected capacity overrides it with floor(max(0,capacity-consumed)/capacity*100). Consumed defaults to 0; callback runs even without active Bat%/Capa binding.
features.aerodeck: Uses current native Bat% first; only if absent and selected pack plus current numeric Capa are present, derives clamped remaining and marks estimated (~).
features.consequence: AERO avoids fabricating100% from absent consumption. Neither calculation accounts for partial starting charge without reset/full-pack assumptions.

features.toolbox: Generic SNV bar normalizes cell voltage within configured min/max; battery status rail can display this normalized percentage. This is a voltage-range measure, not measured remaining capacity.
features.aerodeck: Remaining percentage is actual Bat% or explicitly estimated from consumed capacity; no voltage-derived charge estimate is invented.
features.consequence: If added, label voltage-range/estimate clearly instead of implying state of charge.

features.toolbox: TLMUPDS samples native sourceID+1 and sourceID+2 into rValMin/rValMax.
features.aerodeck: Does not read native extrema. Power/RC traces retain up to90 foreground samples, sampled once per second while app runs.
features.consequence: Native extrema and peak/low summaries are genuine additional data, distinct from short foreground traces.

features.toolbox: Below1000 uses mAh; above1000 switches to Ah with dynamic precision. Original bytecode confirms conditional logic lost by decompiler.
features.aerodeck: Primary consumed counter remains mAh, uses measured fitting and falls back to17px for longer values; Power page always shows mAh.
features.consequence: Optional readability improvement for very large consumed totals; current2762mAh is intentionally29px.

features.toolbox: Per-cell no-power/min/critical/low/max config; visual sound/haptic combinations and critical-only vs critical+low. Background MAIN telemetry gate runs warning checks only when protocol/telemetry enabled and cell>no-power; original ML PCs288–331 verify this is outside DEVON. Critical/low tick cycles are4s/6s; UI mute suppresses alerts.
features.aerodeck: Same broad threshold categories with full-page warnings; nativefloat32 boundary fix rounds0.1mV/cell. Tone/haptic repeat at most every10s, only full app; no explicit mute control. Uses current voltage and configured cells.
features.consequence: Cadence/mute differ. No power/no known cells cannot produce battery alarm; do not alter alarm policy as a workaround for missing sources.

features.toolbox: BTC draws individual cells only if BT_MD_CELLS_V/BT_MD_CELL_V exist. Local source has reset/read references but no data producer for either field in CRSF modules.
features.aerodeck: Only pack-derived average; does not claim individual measured cells.
features.consequence: Do not count the Toolbox screen as a proven working CRSF individual-cell feature or fabricate cells from averages.

features.toolbox: Power comes from EdgeTX telemetry. Verified repeat scheduler requests status/GPS/VTX as applicable, not battery/analog telemetry.
features.aerodeck: MSP client requests only FC_VARIANT2, API_VERSION1, FC_VERSION3, STATUS_EX150. Native power sampling is independent of MSP eligibility.
features.consequence: Do not add continuous MSP power queries or alter the established attitude scheduling to solve an unconfirmed source failure.

features.aerodeck: Compact widget uses uncached unqualified getFieldInfo every refresh; full app uses qualified cached bindings. Same manual source keys, different implementation.
features.consequence: If compact can see power but full app cannot, binding/cache is isolated. Align both readers after verifying live evidence.

prioritizedFixes.action: Correct the parent-confirmed voltage=None AERODECK app mapping only.
prioritizedFixes.acceptance: Current native pack voltage appears; EdgeTX model/FC/RF remain unchanged.

prioritizedFixes.action: Fix negative-cache recovery and shared refresh; make cached source name/ID/current/missing status visible in Power.
prioritizedFixes.acceptance: Late discovery recovers without reopen, stale clears, real0A remains0A, and no sensor-table scan runs every draw.

prioritizedFixes.action: Power actions route consistently to Refresh, configured Sources and battery Limits; derive watts only from current V×A.
prioritizedFixes.acceptance: Missing V or A yields--W; real0A yields0W; derivation sends no telemetry command.

prioritizedFixes.action: Expand favourites to5 and show selected-capacity remainingmAh/percent with honest consumed-data prerequisite.
prioritizedFixes.acceptance: Old profiles survive; no100%/full-capacity remaining is fabricated when Capa is absent; partial-charge assumption remains explicit.

prioritizedFixes.action: Retain the explicit next gaps listed above; do not silently add auto-cells, native extrema, unit scaling or chemistry labels in this power-data fix.
prioritizedFixes.acceptance: Current scope and remaining parity work are separately documented.

liveEvidenceFromParent.voltageIssue: Parent confirmed the active AERODECK app setting voltage=None. The fix changes the app mapping only, not EdgeTX model sensors or FC/RF settings.
liveEvidenceFromParent.currentIssue: This source audit does not prove why current is absent. Preserve unavailable versus real0A and inspect cached native source health.
liveEvidenceFromParent.evidenceQualification: Parent live-state finding; independent source/bytecode audit in this report does not read live hardware values.

currentFailureCauseScope: Voltage disabled mapping confirmed by parent; combined missing-current symptom not independently diagnosed here.
chosenImplementationScope: Fix the active app-only voltage=None mapping; do not alter model sensors, FC or RF settings.
Bounded retry of unresolved source bindings and a visible refresh that invalidates shared bindings/unit metadata; no per-frame sensor inventory scans.
Power page uses cached source health plus Refresh, Sources and Limits actions. Derive watts only from current voltage and current current; missing is not0.
Expand app battery favourites from3 to5 with compatible saved defaults.

Calculate selected-capacity remainingmAh and percent only with current consumedmAh. Percent calculation matches Toolbox underlying capacity-consumed formula; explicit remainingmAh is an AERODECK display enhancement, not a proven Toolbox displayed field.
Maintain current/missing/real-zero distinctions and existing attitude/transport scheduling.
explicitNextGaps: Automatic cell-count inference/connection-latching; current configured cell count is retained.
Native min/max rather than foreground traces.
Typed power-unit validation/conversion for custom mappings; standard CRSF engineering values must not be rescaled.
Chemistry labels and independently enabled favourites/dashboard pack chooser.
Toolbox cadence/mute differences, radio battery display and adaptive Ah formatting.
No individual-cell data producer is proven in Toolbox CRSF source; do not advertise per-cell telemetry from an average.
